---- Respondent
For Petitioner : Ms. Varsha Sharma, Advocate.

For Respondent : Mr. Manoj Bajpai, Adv. on behalf
of Mr. Sandeep Dubey, Adv.
Hon'ble Smt. Justice Rajani Dubey Order on Board 13/02/2023
1.
In the instant petition, the petitioner sought direction from the respondent authorities to take an appropriate decision regarding the representation.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is an old aged person who has suffered from his legitimate claim with regard to proper compensation in lieu of the construction of a drain and road over the land of the petitioner.
The possession of the land of the petitioner has been taken by the respondent way back, but proper compensation has not been awarded by the respondent.

As per the Section 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 provides as under:-
30. Award of Solatium - (1) The collector having determined the total compensation to be paid, shall, to arrive at the final award, impose a "solatium" amount equivalent to one hundred per cent of the compensation amount.

sentences.text: (2) The collector shall issue individual awards detailing the particulars of the compensation payable and the details of payment of the compensation as specified in the first schedule.

(3) In addition to the market value of the land provided under Faguram @ Faggu Prajapti vs Municipal Corporation Bilaspur on 13 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131810602/
1 Section 26

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
, the Collector shall, in every case, award an amount calculated at the rate of twelve per cent per annum on such market value for the period commencing on and from the date of the publication of the notification of the social impact assessment study under sub-section (2) of the Section 4, in respect of such land, till the date of the award of the Collector or the date of taking possession of the land,
whoever is earlier.
3.
Learned counsel for the respondent submits that this petition may be disposed of with a direction to the respondent authority to decide the representation/application of the petitioner.

4. Heard counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.
5.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, it is directed that after due verification the respondent authority shall decide the representation/application of the petitioner according to law at the earliest preferably within a period of 60 days of receipt of copy of this order.
6. With the aforesaid direction, this petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
